newsitem.title: USA: Rexene says court denies dissident request.
newsitem.headline: Rexene says court denies dissident request.

text.p: Rexene Corp said on Wednesday that the Delaware Chancery Court has denied a request by Guy Wyser-Pratte, Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg for an earlier record date for a special shareholder meeting.
The court supported Rexene's board, which set a record date of April 18, 1997, instead of an earlier date the dissident shareholders were seeking, Rexene said.
The special meeting will be held April 30, Rexene said.

Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg, which own a combined 13 percent of the company, aim to replace the company's board of directors and enter a deal to maximize shareholder value, the two companies had said in previous statements.
